story_type: helicopter hoists a ship's captain off a giant car carrier far offshore, filmed air to air
hook: Her captain had stroke symptoms, 150 miles from land.
narration: This helicopter is hovering over a ship nearly two football fields long.
The five hundred ninety foot car carrier Luna Spirit was a hundred fifty miles southeast of Kodiak Island.
Her sixty one year old captain had symptoms of a stroke.
With a stroke, minutes matter. Out here, a helicopter is the only fast way to a hospital.
The Jayhawk crew held a hover beside the towering hull and sent the cable down.
Then they lifted him up from the ship's deck.
outcome: The Kodiak crew hoisted the captain off the Luna Spirit and flew away with him.

location_card.place: 150 miles southeast of Kodiak Island, Alaska

title: Captain airlifted off a giant car carrier
description:
On Dec. 9, 2009, a Kodiak-based Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted the 61-year-old master of the 590-foot car carrier Luna Spirit from the ship's deck about 150 miles southeast of Kodiak Island, Alaska, after he showed symptoms of a stroke.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Sara Francis, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/74795/filipino-man-medevaced-coast-guard-150-miles-offshore
